definitions.ask: Should diagrams four and five require a complex report, a distinct subject, and their own `##` section?
definitions.why: You asked for five only on complicated reports; a flat cap invites quota-filling.

choices.label: Three stays the norm; a 4th or 5th needs a complex report, a new subject, and its own section
One flat cap of five under the existing pass tests; ordinary reports may drift above three

definitions.ask: Should the swarm linker also enforce the five-diagram ceiling?
definitions.why: The linker is the only publisher and already gates every proposal.

choices.label: The linker omits every manifest diagram after the fifth as over the cap
The linker places every valid proposal; only the image agent's prompt holds the cap
